title: Close Relationships with Strangers
description: Close Relationships with Strangers follows a Las Vegas wildlife photographer who moves to Los Angeles to become a paparazzo and in the process loses his relationships, his morals, and eventually his tether to reality.Reviled by celebrities and the public, Ben is one of the last remaining paparazzi scouring the streets of Los Angeles.
